name: Godot Engine
description: A free and open source 2D and 3D game engine.
summary: The Godot Foundation announced that all code must be human-authored: AI may help only with menial things like code completion, regex or find and replace, and any AI use must be disclosed. Autonomous agents and vibe coding lead to a ban, and AI-generated text is not allowed in issues, PRs or proposals, though machine translation of human writing is fine.

evidence.quote: We require all code to be human authored. AI assistance should be limited to menial things (like code completion, regex, or find and replace).
If you do use AI in some capacity to author code, you must disclose it in the PR discussion.
No autonomous AI agent use or vibe coding
Ensuring all contributions are made by humans who can take responsibility for their code and be able and willing to fix it when needed.
When our maintainers volunteer their time to review your issue, PR, or proposal, they do not want to talk to a machine.
No AI-generated text in human-to-human communication
Machine translations are still acceptable as long as the original content was written by a human.

sources.title: Godot: Changes to our Contribution Policies
